findings.issue: הַחֹשֶׁן is a common noun (H2833, singular, definite). Spanish leaves it untranslated as joshen instead of a Spanish common noun.
שְׁתֵּי הַטַּבָּעוֹת licenses one definite pair (two + the rings). Spanish doubles the article.

notes: harás/darás match qal 2ms; עַל, dual two, rings, gold, DOM, and ends are otherwise licensed.
